description: This file defines the base class 'CustomDB' which serves as an abstract implementation for custom database integrations, providing method signatures for common database operations such as get, insert, update, delete, connect, and disconnect.

classes.name: CustomDB
classes.description: A base class that outlines the expected interface for custom database implementations, including methods for data retrieval, insertion, updates, deletions, and connection management.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor for the CustomDB class, initializes the object.

methods.name: get_data(self, key: str, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"])
methods.description: Method to retrieve data from the database given a key and table name.

methods.name: insert_data(self, value: Any, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"])
methods.description: Method to insert new data into the database for a given value and table.

methods.name: update_data( self, key: str, value: Any, table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"] )
methods.description: Method to update existing data identified by key in a specified table.

methods.name: delete_data( self, keys: List[str], table_name: Literal["user", "key", "config"] )
methods.description: Method to delete data identified by a list of keys from a specified table.

methods.name: connect( self, )
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database and sets up required tables.

methods.name: disconnect( self, )
methods.description: Closes the database connection, typically on server shutdown.
